n5b9f73e0ad.headline: The largest Czech internet portal and search engine is completely in Czech hands
n5b9f73e0ad.summary: Seznam.cz, the largest internet portal and search engine in the Czech Republic, has acquired the shares of its two foreign shareholders, becoming fully Czech-owned.
n5b9f73e0ad.why: Seznam.cz is a major digital platform in the Czech Republic; ownership changes may affect its strategic direction and local market influence.
